paper_title: Narrative Media Framing in Political Discourse
caption_used: Distribution of articles across the three-year collection period (2017-2019), displayed as a pie chart with percentage and count labels. The 2019 cohort (blue) represents the largest share at 46.0% (46 articles), followed by 2018 (orange) at 33.0% (33 articles) and 2017 (green) at 21.0% (21 articles). The distribution reflects a steady annual increase, with the 2018-to-2019 growth rate of approximately 25% exceeding the 2017-to-2018 growth rate of roughly 35%. The combined 2017-2018 corpus accounts for slightly over half of all articles at 54%, suggesting that the collection effort intensified primarily in the final year.

model_annotations.English: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of articles across a three-year collection period: 2017, 2018, and 2019. The chart contains three slices, each representing one of the years. The slice for 2019 is blue and occupies approximately 46.0% of the chart, with a count of 46 articles indicated. The 2018 slice is orange, representing 33.0% (33 articles), and the 2017 slice is green, accounting for 21.0% (21 articles). Percentage labels and the article count are shown inside each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, from largest to smallest proportion. A legend is not present, but the years are directly labeled next to their corresponding slices.
model_annotations.German: Das Kreisdiagramm zeigt die Verteilung von Artikeln über einen Zeitraum von drei Jahren (2017-2019). Das Diagramm besteht aus drei Segmenten, die jeweils ein Jahr darstellen. Das Segment, das 2019 darstellt, ist blau und macht ungefähr 46,0 % (46) des Gesamtwerts aus. Das Segment, das 2018 darstellt, ist orange und macht ungefähr 33,0 % (33) des Gesamtwerts aus. Das Segment, das 2017 darstellt, ist grün und macht ungefähr 21,0 % (21) des Gesamtwerts aus. Das Diagramm enthält Prozentangaben und absolute Zählungen innerhalb jedes Segments. Die Segmente sind in absteigender Größe angeordnet, beginnend mit 2019 oben und dann im Uhrzeigersinn 2018 und 2017.
